text:
maria: Quick sync — PR #5427 needs small follow-ups: split the big batching example, add a concise SSE streaming snippet for SDK v2, and fix two links that 404. Trying to land before the optimize release.
sam: I can do SSE + a tiny WebSocket appendix. Plan: show server-side SSE as main example, one-liner resume token, and note to not print raw chunks in prod.
ben: I'll split batching into two minimal snippets: latency-preferred (interactive) and throughput (microbatch). Will include compact YAMLs.
jess: Heads-up: runtime v1.3 renamed quant profiles: old q4_0 -> q4f, q8_0 -> q8f, and added q4f_v2. We need a 2-3 sentence migration note mapping old->new and quick guidance.
kai: After wording lands I'll backport the mapping to /v1 docs and link the runtime release note.
docs-bot: link-check: /optimize/quant -> 404, /sdk/python/streaming -> 404 :warning: 

sam: Proposed SSE snippet (Python, very short):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
with client.text.stream(model="redwood/fast-1", mode="sse") as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        # process tokens in prod; don't print raw chunks
        emit_token(chunk.text)
# resume: resume = StreamResumeToken.from_last(chunk)
```
I'll add the WebSocket appendix after this lands.

ben: YAMLs (kept tiny):
```yaml
# latency-preferred
serving_config:
  batching:
    mode: latency-preferred
    max_batch_size: 8
    max_wait_ms: 20
  caching:
    kv_prefetch: true
    kv_prefetch_window: 32
```
```yaml
# throughput (microbatch)
serving_config:
  batching:
    mode: microbatch
    max_batch_size: 128
    max_wait_ms: 150
  caching:
    prefix_cache: true
    prefix_cache_ttl_sec: 600
```
I'll add a one-line note about warming KV cache for short-seq workloads.

jess: Suggested quant paragraph: "Runtime v1.3 renamed q4_0 -> q4f and q8_0 -> q8f; a newer q4f_v2 variant increases throughput with modest edge-case regressions. For short interactive web flows prefer q4f; evaluate q4f_v2 for bulk throughput on your eval set." I'll keep it to two sentences and link runtime notes.

maria: Action items: sam update SSE + fix links; ben split batching + add YAMLs; jess add quant mapping; kai backport after merge. I'll review and prioritize once PRs appear. Let's aim to merge within 48h. :thumbsup:
